construct: PAX2 encodes a transcription factor required for normal embryonic development of the kidneys and eyes. Loss of functional PAX2 can disrupt formation of renal tissue and the optic nerve, producing congenital kidney abnormalities with optic nerve coloboma; inheritance is autosomal dominant when a pathogenic PAX2 variant is present.

distractor_audit.rationale: Alport syndrome is a hereditary type IV collagen disorder classically associated with hematuric kidney disease, sensorineural hearing loss, and ocular abnormalities rather than bilateral optic nerve colobomas with hypoplastic kidneys.

Autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease causes progressive formation of numerous renal cysts with kidney enlargement rather than congenital optic nerve colobomas and bilaterally hypoplastic kidneys.

Tuberous sclerosis complex causes multisystem benign tumors, including renal tumors, together with characteristic neurologic and skin manifestations; it does not produce the PAX2-pattern combination of optic nerve coloboma and renal hypoplasia.

Autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease is typically apparent at birth or in early infancy and is characterized by cystic kidney disease, not this autosomal-dominant optic-nerve-coloboma and renal-hypoplasia phenotype.

educational_objective_text: Recognize renal coloboma syndrome from congenital kidney disease plus optic nerve coloboma and connect the phenotype to PAX2-dependent embryonic development.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Progressive kidney disease with bilaterally hypoplastic kidneys plus bilateral optic-nerve colobomas in a son and affected father is the classic developmental kidney-eye combination of PAX2-related renal coloboma syndrome.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Alport syndrome causes hematuric glomerular disease with hearing and ocular abnormalities but not this optic-nerve-coloboma/renal-hypoplasia pair. ADPKD and ARPKD are cystic kidney disorders; tuberous sclerosis causes multisystem hamartomas rather than this developmental pattern.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Optic nerve coloboma plus renal hypoplasia is sufficiently specific, and the autosomal-dominant pedigree further supports renal coloboma syndrome.
